about: Held-out questions for reference lookup ranking. Written 2026-11-15 before any ranking change and before searching the index for any of them; committed on their own so the order is provable. A question is found when a passage whose source is one of 'sources' and whose title matches 'title' (Python re.search) is among the k=5 passages retrieve() returns without a model. Do not tune ranking against this set; it is scored once, for the chosen rule and the baseline. Questions marked absent have no matching page in references-next.sqlite (checked by title only, after the first commit, without searching) and are left out of the score; the bug-check pattern was anchored on ':' in the same follow-up because '0x1E' also matched 0x1E1..0x1E9.
